name: Boat24
notes: Europe-wide brokerage and private listings. It refuses anything that is not a browser — even its home page answers 403 to a plain request — so this source is rendered in WebKit. Boat24 files by builder rather than free text, so the name goes straight into the path: /en/sailingboats/grinde/. Verified: that page lists a Grinde in Germany at EUR 25,000.

name: Dansk Grinde Klub
notes: The class association's own for-sale page. A fixed page, not a search — the boats that never reach the classifieds appear here first. Price is read out of the headline, which is how the club writes them.

name: DBA.dk
notes: Verified: the page publishes every result as schema.org Product with name, price, image and url. No selectors to keep alive.

name: Blocket
notes: Verified: the results page publishes schema.org Products with name, price, image and url, and the reader handles it. Note that Blocket's general marketplace does not appear to carry the boat vertical — a Grinde advertised under Båtar is not in these results. Paste the URL of a Blocket boat ad into Test and the search URL can be pointed at the right vertical in one pass.
